subject_definitions
<Subject 1>: One premium chocolate-chip cookie with a thick golden-brown body, crisp irregular edge, porous buttery crumb, caramelized surface, scattered dark chocolate chunks, and a warm elastic molten-chocolate center. Maintain one consistent cookie design throughout the video.
<Subject 2>: One transparent cylindrical glass filled nearly to the rim with cold fresh milk. The glass has realistic thickness, refraction, reflections, and soft condensation.
<Video 1>: The supplied CookieMilkImpact demonstration video. Use it only as the strict reference for camera choreography, close-up viewpoints, composition, subject trajectory, action order, and timing. It is not a visual-quality or realism reference.
summary
video editing + reference generation. Transform the simplified demonstration in <Video 1> into a high-end 10-second photorealistic cookie advertisement. Preserve its close-up camera angles, camera movements, action sequence, and impact timing, while completely redrawing the cookie, chocolate, glass, milk, lighting, materials, and liquid splash with premium commercial realism.
retention_analysis
<Video 1>: fully_preserved for shot order, elevated three-quarter close-up, frontal macro angle, camera height, lens perspective, centered composition, pull-back and push-in timing, cookie separation, reassembly, falling trajectory, impact timing, and final framing.
<Video 1>: weak_reference for visual appearance, materials, lighting, geometry, and fluid behavior. Do not reproduce its low-poly shapes, flat shading, simplified textures, rigid milk spikes, or stylized splash.
<Subject 1> and <Subject 2>: fully_preserved for product identity and physical continuity.
Realism requirement: replace every simplified effect with physically plausible food textures, high-speed liquid behavior, accurate reflections, refraction, surface tension, gravity, and secondary droplets. Do not copy reference audio.
detailed_description
Luxury photorealistic food advertising, captured with a cinema-grade macro lens and high-speed camera. Warm directional key light, soft fill, controlled highlights, shallow depth of field, rich microtexture, and a clean brown-to-cream studio background. The reference video defines blocking and camera movement only; all visible assets must be rebuilt at premium advertising quality.
[Shot 1] Match <Video 1>’s elevated three-quarter close-up. <Subject 1> fills approximately 70–80% of the frame. Reveal crisp baked edges, tiny sugar crystals, toasted pores, buttery crumb, and realistic dark-chocolate reflections. Preserve the reference’s centered framing and restrained opening camera movement.
From 00:00.700 to 00:02.400, irregular chocolate chunks fall from above and land on the warm cookie, matching the reference trajectory and rhythm. Each piece has believable mass: it bounces once, rotates, casts a contact shadow, and settles slightly into the soft surface. Tiny crumbs react to impact.
From 00:02.400 to 00:03.300, reproduce the reference’s rapid pull-back and viewpoint change as the cookie separates into two symmetrical halves. Keep it as a close product shot. The fracture exposes a moist, porous interior rather than a smooth artificial cut.
From 00:03.300 to 00:06.700, adopt the reference’s near-frontal macro angle and slow push-in. The halves move apart while multiple glossy strands of molten chocolate stretch between them. The chocolate behaves as a hot viscous food material: strands elongate unevenly, narrow under tension, sag slightly under gravity, and remain connected. Show subtle steam, soft crumbs, oily highlights, and realistic depth. Avoid rubber-like strings or perfectly uniform lines.
[Shot 2] At 00:06.700, match the reference transition to a tight frontal close-up of <Subject 2>. The milk glass dominates the lower frame; the reassembled cookie enters partially cropped from above. Preserve the reference camera height, lens perspective, composition, fall path, and speed.
From 00:07.000 to 00:08.500, the cookie strikes the center of the milk. Completely redraw the impact as physically accurate high-speed fluid photography. Milk first forms a compressed depression around the cookie, then rises into a thick asymmetric crown-shaped sheet. Surface tension rounds the edges before the sheet breaks into droplets of varied sizes. Include fine mist, thin connecting filaments, secondary droplets, transparent edge highlights, realistic motion blur, concentric waves, reflections on the glass rim, and milk displaced against the inner glass wall. The cookie becomes partially wet and darkens where it contacts the milk.
From 00:08.500 to 00:10.000, hold the close-up as gravity pulls the liquid sheet down. Droplets fall back naturally, generating smaller secondary splashes and fading ripples. No rigid spikes, polygonal liquid, paper-like sheets, frozen droplets, overflowing geometry, hands, packaging, text, logos, or additional products.
overall_soundscape
Close tactile food audio: weighted chocolate impacts, crisp cookie fracture, sticky molten-chocolate stretch, a brief camera whoosh, then a deep rounded milk impact with layered splash, droplets striking glass and liquid, and gradually settling ripples. No dialogue and no copied reference audio.
non_diegetic_music
Elegant premium commercial music with muted bass, delicate marimba, soft pizzicato strings, and restrained cinematic percussion. Synchronize accents with the falling chocolate, cookie separation, reassembly, and milk impact; briefly reduce the music at impact so the realistic splash sound dominates.
